items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Then I did another record that sold almost two million records -- that was Perez Prado, a tune called 'Patricia'. ... it was the first time I ever heard a base guitar on a recording. It was Billy Muir, Alan Hannon and myself.

ctx.x: Right, the first overdub. There were these tapes sitting up on the shelf that Perez Prado had recorded out in California. So they brought the tapes in to New York to Herman Diez, who was the A+R man at the time at RCA.
